notes:
- Pressing the unlock hotkey now also unlocks the Fight History window
- Damage breakdowns in the rift recap window now show a condensed version of the breakdown and fit neatly into the UI
- Dying no longer stops the meter if your party is still alive
- Delete buttons have been added to log entries in the log list so you don't have to open the log to delete it anymore
- Reduced log list's page size by 1 so you don't need to scroll to see the last entry anymore
- Mobs killed before the start of the Gate Phase in Rifts will no longer count towards damage done during the Gate Phase
- Chakram's first phase (before surrendering to darkness) now counts as a separate fight from his other phases
